title: Strongblade
description:
Your favorite gameplay: match-3 puzzle game with building elements! Play three-in-a-row and set up impressive campgrounds!
Hundreds of varied levels with incredible boosters and explosive combinations!
Lots of game events and tough challenges! Complete exciting quests to upgrade your camp!
Atmospheric fantasy world: detailed animations, picturesque landscapes and charming characters!
Interesting characters who are ready to become your friends and join your journey!

title: Stickman Punishment
description: When a mysterious radiation blast grants Stickman and his friends superpowers, heartbreak quickly turns into a quest for revenge! Betrayed by his best friend over a girl, Stickman discovers he can morph into any shape imaginable. Now, he’s ready to use his new abilities to create chaos and keep the pair apart. Dive into this action-packed story filled with unique animations, clever payback strategies, and endless creativity!

title: Tobinin
description: Step into the mind-bending world of Tobinin, a fast-paced puzzle-action platformer where every move alters reality! Collect orbs to switch platforms and navigate through a world that constantly shifts beneath your feet. Can you master the art of controlled chaos and reach the goal?

title: Energy Clicker
description:
Enter the captivating world of Energy Clicker and become a true master of electricity generation! You will take control of the main character who, by pressing the generator pedal, unleashes immense power and lights up the windows of the city. However, be careful because if the energy exceeds the permissible value, your generator will start to break down!
Become a leader in electricity generation and show everyone your energetic side in Energy Clicker.

title: Mahjong Lines
description: Mahjong Lines is a relaxing logic puzzle in the mahjong connect style. Find matching tile pairs and clear the board by linking them with a valid path. With classic mahjong tiles, simple rules, hints, and lots of levels, it’s perfect for both quick sessions and thoughtful puzzle-solving.

title: Zombie Rush
description:
Zombies Rush is a fast-paced top-down survival shooter that pits a lone survivor against an endless, evolving horde. Built for fluid action, this 2D arcade shooter, turns every escape into a high-stakes dance with death.
Tilt and weave through trees to outmaneuver the rush.
Each wave brings faster, smarter, and deadlier undead threats.
Experience a modern take on the classic zombie survival genre with clean, stylized graphics and kinetic combat.

title: Fire And Water Birds
description: Try to get the water and fire birds through challenging obstacles to get the highest score and become the master of the birds. a challenging adventure awaits you. Come on!

description:
Pixel Path is a platformer with a non—standard plot.?
Get to the portal at the end of the level to win, but it's not as easy as it might seem... The floor may collapse, the spikes will move on you, and your character will grow to huge sizes. One wrong step and the game is over.❌
You will have to keep your sanity, expect surprises, show a good reaction and most importantly: do not get angry.?
The game also has a table of the best players who completed all levels faster than the rest.

title: Merge Heroes
description:
In this game, you will command squads of melee fighters and ranged archers fighting against waves of enemies. Your agility and strategic thinking will give you an edge to victory.

Unlock new powerful fighters and accurate archers by combining those available for purchase. Place them on the map according to abilities and win.

You will have to discover not only new characters, but also beautiful different worlds, enjoy our new game.

Feed, walk and play with your space friends to give them happiness and care. Support your pets so that they please you with their devotion and love.

Laugh and prank the teacher in this fun school game!

Step into the edgy world of Grunge Chic Alt Fashion, where style meets attitude. This dress-up game lets you explore the perfect mix of grunge edge and chic sophistication.

From plaid skirts and ripped jeans to oversized jackets, fishnets, and combat boots—you’ll have endless options to design your alternative fashion star. Top it off with smoky makeup, bold lipstick, and layered accessories to complete the vibe.

Play solo to reach the highest score or battle others in PvP mode to climb the leaderboard and achieve ultimate glory in Asgard!

In this captivating puzzle platformer, guide your worm to the legendary Golden Apple while navigating devious obstacles and perilous chasms. The secret to success? Mastering your worm's growing length.

description: Tap connected blocks to clear them! If any blocks are left, you will lose life. The game ends when your life reaches 0. You can use placed special bombs by tapping them.

description: Step into the Halloween fun with Falling Blocks - Halloween Challenge, a thrilling match-3 arcade game! You play as a sweet girl walking through the forest with her cat, Lassie.
Our girl was walking and everything was wonderful: the birds were singing, the flowers were a delight to the eye, and suddenly the cat meowed and ran off into the depths of the forest.
Our girl searched for her cat in the forest for a long time and didn't notice how night had fallen. Wandering through the forest, the girl came across an old house. What if our cat ran in there?

title: Cunning Ginger
description: Cunning Ginger is a super fun game that'll give you lots of excitement and intense emotions! The game follows the adventures of a cute red cat, Ginger, as he goes on a great journey around the world. He's catching falling food items and dodging all sorts of dangerous things along the way. Your goal in the game is to help Ginger explore the world and pick up as many goodies as possible. But beware - there are tons of dangerous obstacles that could harm your furry friend.

title: Super Slime
description: Super Slime is a fast-paced platformer where you take control of a squishy, bouncy hero on a mission to save the day. Master the art of stretching, bouncing, and dodging through 100 thrilling levels packed with tricky obstacles and fierce enemies. Precision and quick reflexes are your best allies in this adorable yet challenging adventure!

title: Spider Bubu
description: Spider-Bubu swings from wall to wall across the city. Halloween has arrived, and you need to collect all the Halloween candies along with Spider-Bubu. Don’t forget to grab the giant pumpkin too! You must be very careful in the city — sharp spinning blades and pointed spikes are everywhere. Collect all the pumpkins and safely reach the portal that appears in the city.

title: Cute Kitty Merge
description: Step into the role of a farmer and grow your own fruits and vegetables. In Solitaire TriPeaks Farming you will spend time in beautiful nature and play fun and constantly changing levels that will never allow for boredom. It is all about having fun.

description: In the realm of slumber, dreams manifest as delicate tiles, each holding a fragment of imagination, memory, or longing. As a Dream Collector, your mission is to weave these ephemeral pieces together, creating a tapestry of wonder. Only by assembling the perfect dream can you unlock hidden secrets and awaken the Dream Oracle.

title: Kung-Fu Little Animals
description: In this game you will become the new assistant of the Great Master. Your task is to teach funny and dexterous animals the art of kung fu. With simple clicks, you will train your newly minted students so that they become worthy successors of the Great Master's work. Passing the game, you will discover new funny animals, as well as new beautiful and unusual locations. Join the kung fu team and have fun teaching the little animals martial arts!

title: Barry Prison Christmas Adventure
description: Want the craziest Christmas escape adventure ever? Barry Prison Christmas Adventure is an exciting role-playing simulator. Enter chase mode or evade mode. Here, you will play the role of either the hider or the seeker. Select your preferred scenario to begin the challenge. Find a hidden spot to start hiding and evade your pursuers.

title: Triple Shelf Match
description:
A relaxing D puzzle game about sorting goods on shelves. Find identical items, match them in groups of three, and clear space to complete each level.
As you progress, the shelves become more challenging: more goods, less free space, and smarter moves are needed. Use boosters, plan ahead, and enjoy the satisfying feeling of organizing everything in the right place.

title: Ping Pong Air
description: Table tennis, also known as ping pong, is an easy and enjoyable arcade game in which you control the bat as simply as in life: with the mouse or the movement of your finger. Several modes await you to suit every taste. In classic mode, you go through worlds, earn cups and unlock new opportunities. In Halloween mode, you have to banish spirits for a while, improving your reaction. In Career mode, you move up the tournament ladder, taking part in games against increasingly stronger opponents.

title: Geometry Arrow

Put your skills to the test in this high-speed action game!

imple Yet Addictive Gameplay: Just drag and release to align the planets. Watch as they combine into spectacular new celestial bodies.

title: Unstack Tower
description: Unstack Tower is a puzzle game that challenges players to dismantle a tower of colorful cubes in the correct order. Every move matters—remove or drop blocks carefully to keep the structure stable while freeing space for the next step. Different block materials such as glass or wood add variety and difficulty, making each level unique. With its blend of strategy and reflex-based gameplay, Unstack Tower offers a mix of tension and fun that keeps players engaged.

description:
Knit Rescue is an engaging and original puzzle game where you untangle a knitted dragon to save a frightened kitten.

But it’s not enough to simply tap the right spools. You must unlock the correct spools and move them in the right direction to stop the dragon in time.

Plan your moves, follow the arrows, and solve each level using logic and strategy. Knit Rescue is the perfect casual puzzle game for fans of brain games, logic puzzles, and strategy games.

relaxing ASMR sound experience.

Embark on exciting missions, compete with other players and prove your skills in this epic Car Derby Arena game!

Create unique sports looks: from elegant dresses for the opening ceremony to uniforms for training. Mix colors, accessories and shoes to make each monstro-athlete shine in her own way. The Lunar League is waiting for its champions!

The closer your slice is to the center, the better your score. Simple controls, smooth animation, and bright graphics make every level fun and challenging. Test your reflexes, aim for three stars, and unlock new levels in this exciting game for all ages!

Customize your car's appearance and performance. All this chaos is accompanied by your cute dog. Whether evading the cops or just cruising, Aventador Vice Crime City offers a thrilling and visually amazing experience.

description: Splash around in a sea of bubbles, dance to pumping beats, and compete against friends in wild and energetic beauty challenges. Ready to get the fun started? Then join Gina and Selena in this colorful, summer-themed makeover game for girls, and help them deal with their dazzling party looks. From scrubbing and skincare to makeup and fabulous fashion, you’re the ultimate stylist, ensuring these besties shine bright under the Ibiza sun.

title: The Final Riddle
description: It's a unique experimental puzzle game, where all you are given is the title of your current puzzle. If you get the hint, you know what to do, how to arrange the blocks and solve the riddle.

title: Bomby
description: Launch into fun with Bomby Birds, a slingshot arcade game inspired by the style of Angry Birds! Pull, aim, and fling your bird through tricky levels filled with blocks and obstacles. Perfect for students searching cool math games, bird games, or quick school break fun. With addictive gameplay, silly physics, and nonstop action, Bomby is the ultimate free kids game for anyone who loves arcade challenges and slingshot adventures!

title: Car Jam Escape
description: Car Jam Escape is a puzzle game where players clear a crowded parking lot by moving cars in the correct order. Each vehicle can only move forward in the direction it faces, so players must study the layout and plan carefully. The goal is to guide every car out without collisions or blockages. As levels progress, the puzzles become more complex, requiring logical thinking and strategy.

title: Hexa Sort Master
description:
Let's sort some hexa blocks on the hexa tiles. Hexa blocks consist of colorful pieces. Place the same colored pieces side by side and match them to stack all hexas over one tile.
A great puzzle game begins with colorful hexa blocks! Sort the stacks side by side and try to destroy them making hexa towers. Match the same colors with each other. Exercise and improve your brain skills. More than 200 levels are waiting for you!

title: Candy Monster Raffi
description: Help the candy monster Raffi eat all the candies! He absolutely loves them – all he wants is to eat candy. But be careful while collecting them! If you jump in the wrong direction, you might hit dangerous spikes. This cute little monster is hungry – run and feed Raffi with as many candies as you can!

title: Idle Animal Anatomy
description: Idle Animal Anatomy is a clicker game where you can create living organisms from scratch. The goal of the game is to create an animal cell by cell, and this will make you feel like a scientist.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Crash the Robot!
description:
An addictive physics puzzle game, the goal of which is to crash the robot on each level in all sorts of ways or give him the opportunity to do so himself. Arrange items from your inventory and trigger a chain of events to reach the goal! Also use cannons and jumppads.

The game has over 50 levels +5 bonus levels!

title: Pool Master
description: From a rookie with a cue to a legend of the table, journey through 100 challenging levels with closed pockets, special balls to clear and more. Unlock custom gear, gain special boosts and rule the table with precision and power.

title: Halloween Store Sort
description: In Halloween Store Sort, match spooky toys and Halloween decorations by dragging them between shelves. Create sets of three to clear the shelves and reveal hidden ones above or to the sides of the screen. With many levels and increasing difficulty, each level has a time limit, so think fast! Use the shuffle button if you get stuck. Complete all levels to win and become the ultimate Halloween sorting champion!

title: Dusty Maze Hunter
description:
Dusty Maze Hunter beckons you to a distinctive maze adventure, blending puzzle-solving with strategic gameplay.

Tailored for puzzle enthusiasts and casual gamers, it promises an exhilarating journey through labyrinthine rooms filled with diverse obstacles. As you progress through multiple levels, you'll have the chance to refine your problem-solving skills and strategic thinking.

Are you prepared to unleash your strategy and triumph over the dust? The maze adventure awaits!

title: Escape Room Mystery Key
description: Escape Room Mystery Key is an intense escape room adventure filled with horror and puzzle elements. Choose a role to enter an abandoned school or a hospital. Uncover hidden clues and keys to find your way out. In this game, you must carefully examine every detail in the room, searching for hidden clues.

title: Limited Defense
description:
Limited Defense is a strategic tower defense game where you command bandits, archers, and explosive towers to hold back relentless waves of enemies. Face off against mischievous Green Slimes, fearsome Orcs, and towering bosses like the Boss King Slime. Upgrade your defenses, unlock legendary warriors, and test your tactical skills in intense, fast-paced battles!
Can you make it in this tower defense game?

title: Cyberpunk City Hairstyles
description: Cyberpunk City Hairstyles is a beauty game where you can take hairstyling to a whole new level! Practice your professional haircare routine to transform Emma's frizzy hair into vibrant, edgy masterpieces.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Mahjong Four Rivers
description: Discover the engaging world of Mahjong Four Rivers – a fresh take on the classic puzzle game. With its traditional charm and modern gameplay, it’s perfect for sharpening your observation and strategy skills. Enjoy beautifully designed tiles and the rewarding challenge of clearing the board. Play for free on your phone or computer, wherever you are.

title: ASMR Beauty Superstar
description: Welcome to ASMR Clinic, where relaxation meets rejuvenation! Our superstar guest is receiving expert care for acne-prone skin and rough feet in a serene atmosphere. Our skilled doctors will work their magic, providing personalized attention to detail and soothing care. Customize her look with various hairstyles, makeup looks, and shoes to create a stunning outfit that's uniquely hers. Unwind and express your creativity in this calming and fashionable game.

title: Cat Challenge
description: Meet the game Cat Challenge, where at each level the cat will patiently wait until you drop him a round colored candy disc. To do this, you need to cut the rope on which the candy dangles. But first, think about which side to do this and take into account the items that are on the playing field, they must be used to achieve the goal. The candy is not always directly above the cat, so it needs to be moved somehow.

title: Magnet Truck
description: What happens if you take a car with a huge magnet? It could pull metal right out of the ground and rocks! Upgrade and get more and more expensive metals!

title: The Superhero League
description: Want to join the Superhero League and unlock endless puzzle fun? In The Superhero League, you’ll become a superhero and begin an exciting puzzle adventure. Take on various killing missions, solve puzzles, and save the world. Control your hero through challenging levels and become the strongest hero of all! This creative puzzle game combines superhero elements with rich strategy gameplay.

title: Hoard Master
description: Hoard Master is a game to test your speed and responsiveness. Your goal is to collect more and more people, but you should prevent the income of explosives to avoid failure. Are you interested?

title: GT Cars City Racing
description: GT Cars City Racing is a driving game with a fantastic open world, epic stunts and magnificent super stylized cars! The game, which brings many innovations and game-play to its previous series GT Cars Mega Ramps, has different surprises waiting for you in its 2nd series. The open world, which is especially demanded by the players, was designed as a Toy City. Incredible shows in the Toy City offer a dazzling game-play experience and never-ending action!

title: Highway Bus Rush
description: Welcome to the heart-pounding world of "Highway Bus Rush" – a game that propels you into an exhilarating journey along infinite highways. Brace yourself as you surge forward, navigating the ever-changing landscapes with precision and speed. The relentless pursuit of adrenaline awaits, as you weave through traffic and conquer challenging obstacles.

title: Words from words: Sea
description:
An exciting game where you need to find words from the given letters and solve hidden words in crosswords.  

Welcome to the game "Words from words: Sea" - where many words and interesting crosswords are waiting for you. Make words from letters, discover new words from words, and enjoy the amazing world where words turn into magic. Join us right now and dive into the world of fillwords, creating and finding the most amazing words!  

Dive into the world of exciting levels and find all the words!

title: Mini Games Casual Collection
description:
Mini Games: Casual Collection is an online game. The gameplay is simple, fun, and addictive, so
you won't be able to stop playing. There is no stamina display. You can play anytime anywhere. You can use hints to help you pass when you are stuck on a level. If you have any problems playing this game or have any suggestions for this game, please leave us a message. If you like our games, please share them with your friends to double the fun!

title: SUIKA WATERMELON DROP
description: Engage, merge, and challenge yourself in this thrilling fruit-matching journey! Drop and collide identical fruits to evolve them, preventing them from falling out of the box. But here's the exciting twist: every time matching fruits collide, they transform into a completely new one. Can you keep merging your way up to the ultimate prize, the grand watermelon? The challenge awaits!

title: ASMR Beauty Homeless
description: One of our patrons came in today with her homeless friend, Anna, who is in need of urgent hygiene care. Let’s assist the doctor in cleaning her body, teeth, and the area around her piercing. After the treatment, style her in the best outfit!

title: Geometry Rush 4D
description: Geometry Rush 4D is an exhilarating 4D platformer that takes speed, precision, and reflexes to the next level. In this fast-paced, action-packed game, you guide a customizable character through vibrant, geometric worlds filled with intricate obstacles and dynamic traps. The game's signature dash mechanic allows players to perform rapid movements, weaving through ever-changing environments with seamless control.

title: Brick Breaker
description: Smash bricks in this fast-paced Arkanoid-style arcade classic! Aim, launch, and chain massive combos with NICE, GREAT, AWESOME, and INSANE streaks. Collect 5 power-ups: Extra Ball, Double Ball, Bomb Shot, HP Reduce, and Shield. Battle through 100 stages with unique layouts and epic boss fights every 10 levels. Bricks descend each turn — don't let them reach the bottom! Neon-glow visuals, smooth controls, and endless replayability. Can you reach Stage 100?

title: ASMR Girl: Livestream Mukbang
description: Step into the world of ASMR Girl: Livestream Mukbang, where you take on the role of an adorable mukbang streamer! Get ready to indulge in delicious food, satisfy your cravings, and share the experience with your viewers in a cozy, interactive livestream. The more you eat and engage, the more you earn!

title: Ninja Crossword Challenge
description: It's time to test your vocabulary with Ninja Crossword Challenge, an educational puzzle online game for everyone, and a free game for kids to improve their vocabulary. All you have to do is fill in the words in the grid, the game has more vocabulary than you can imagine, ready to take on my challenge?

title: Stupidity Test
description: Stupidity Test is a quiz game that lets you find out how stupid you really are! Answer some simple logical questions that may include colors, shapes, and simple math and see how well you do.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Meme challenge.io
description:
"Meme Challenge.io" is straight-up chaos.
It’s you vs. the wildest, most unhinged character names ever like Spaghetti Tualetti and Bombardino Crocodilo. Tap fast, think faster, and don’t get caught slippin’. It’s giving brain-lag.
Only real ones can vibe their way to the Wcup.

title: Color Block Jam 2
description: Play Color Block Jam 2 free online in your browser with no download and no install required. This free online puzzle game lets you slide colorful blocks into matching gates through smart logic levels designed to test your brain and timing. Perfect for fans of cool math games, unblocked games, and quick school breaks, it loads fast and works smoothly on desktop and mobile. Enjoy relaxing color block puzzles anytime, anywhere, completely free.

title: Sweeper Curling
description:
Sweeper Curling is a fun and easy ice curling game for the whole family!
Slide your stones down the ice, aim for the target, and sweep to control
the speed. Play against a smart AI or challenge a friend in 2-player mode.
Simple controls and colorful graphics make it easy for everyone to enjoy!

title: Archers Ragdoll Physics
description: Archers Ragdoll Physics is a physics-based archery action game where ragdoll characters fight using special arrows. The game features 10 characters and 12 unique arrows such as lightning, fire, poison, missile, and rocket. Players can equip three arrows and switch between them during battles. Some levels include traps like electric cables and spinning gears that can be activated with arrows. In 2 Player Mode, players choose from 7 arrows and compete to hit their opponent the most.

title: Photo Block Journey
description: Move picture blocks across the board and place them in the right order to complete the image. Look carefully at the layout, plan your moves, and find the best way to solve each puzzle. The gameplay is simple from the first level: slide the tiles, open the path, and complete the picture.

title: Drill Quest
description:
Drill Quest is a casual game combining the excitement of crushing blocks, upgrading your drill, and building your city. 

Explore diverse locations, progressively upgrade your equipment, and choose from machines.

title: Bank Robbery: Escape
description: Bank Robbery: Escape is an intense FPS game title in shooting category, where your mission is to bust your crew out of a heavily guarded police station. Navigate through relentless police raids, arm yourself with the best gear, and make your escape before time runs out—or face the consequences. Will you outsmart the law or go down in a blaze of glory?

title: Bunnyhop and Surf Maps
description: Game that brings bunnyhop and surf from "Counter Strike" straight to your browser! The game features a variety of parkour maps, many knife skins, unique bunnyhop mechanics, the ability to accelerate with a knife, and the opportunity to compete with other players to see who can reach the finish line first.

title: Future War: Bot Battle in Space 3D
description: Future War: Bot Battle in Space 3D is a real-time strategy game that rewards creativity, depth of strategy, and adaptability. Victory depends on your ability to design and deploy customizable and programmable units to dominate the battlefield.

title: Murderers VS Sheriffs Duels
description:
Love Roblox-style action games? Get ready for the ultimate showdown!

Jump into fast-paced 1v1, 2v2, 3v3, and 4v4 duels where every second counts. Play as a Murderer or a Sheriff, master unique abilities, and outplay your enemies in style.

If you enjoy games like Murder Mystery or Arsenal in Roblox, this is made for you!

title: Cryptogram: Word Brain Puzzle
description: Cryptogram: Word Brain Puzzle presents a fresh take on the classic word puzzle genre. With an array of unique gameplay mechanics, hints, and events, players are immersed in an engaging experience. The game's USP is its diverse content, offering a wide range of quotes across various themes, from inspirational to literary and beyond.

title: Burger Day
description: Burger Day is a fun and fast-paced arcade game that puts you in charge of a busy burger kitchen. Stack ingredients to serve up tasty orders as quickly as possible. Your speed and decision-making skills are tested as customer demands increase. Satisfy hungry customers to unlock fresh challenges and advance through exciting levels.

title: Rift of Hell-Demons War
description:
Hordes of insidious demons are lurking in the hellish catacombs! Can you challenge hundreds of hellish creatures and destroy them all as you descend closer to the citadel?
You have several types of weapons at your disposal and an almost endless supply of ammo along the way!
With each step, collecting gold that falls from enemies, you will become stronger and stronger, strength, speed of movement, arsenal of deadly weapons, armor - all this will depend on your actions.

title: BillyTheBox
description:
Want to deep dive into a cute graphics cozy puzzle game? BilBox is for you.

Simple puzzle game which can be enjoyed by anyone who loves playing cozy puzzle games with fun elements.

title: Backyard Dig Hole 3D Simulator
description:
Become a Gemstone Hunter in Your Own Backyard!

Ever dreamed of being a real miner and digging for treasure in your own backyard? Backyard Dig Hole 3D Simulator brings that fantasy to life with realistic graphics that make you feel like you're truly digging deep to find valuable gemstones and metals hidden beneath the earth!

title: Mahjong At Home - Scandinavian Edition
description: Immerse yourself in the minimalist elegance of the North with 'Mahjong at Home: Scandinavian Winter Edition'. This high-quality Mahjong game celebrates the sleek, modern design of Scandinavian style, blending festive themes with clean, sophisticated aesthetics for a uniquely cozy winter gaming experience.

title: Idle Lawnmower
description: In Idle Lawnmower, embrace the tranquility of tending to your virtual lawn, earning gold with each satisfying swath cut. Utilize your earnings to upgrade your lawnmower, enhancing efficiency and earning potential in this idle game of grassy growth and financial gain.

title: Crazy Bike Stunts PvP
description: Skid the wheel of a stunning muscle car through 2 awesome game modes and showcase your driving skills. Customize your car according to your taste and drive in style with the roaring engines. Feel the heat in 2 player mode where you go head to head with your friend in 2 amazing game modes! Are you ready to conquer the stunt city? Prove yourself with Crazy Bike Stunts PvP!

title: Sisyphus Simulator
description: An addictive and challenging hyper-casual 3D game. Push the rock up the hill cleverly so that it won't fall down. Reach the top of the hill and collect the honor star to complete the challenge and raise your name on the Honor Board.

title: Tile Living
description: Select matching tiles that can be connected with up to 3 straight lines to clear them! Clear all the tiles to complete the stage! Use the coins you collect from clearing stages to decorate your room!

title: Divinex
description:
Embark on a captivating journey into the world of Divinex! Solve challenging puzzles by matching pairs of themed tiles adorned with intricate symbols! Сhallenge yourself with increasingly difficult levels, create a unique atmosphere by choosing new avatars and backgrounds. Immerse yourself in the magical world of Divinex - a new relaxing game with stunning visuals - explore all levels and uncover the magic hidden within the tiles!
Begin your journey today with Divinex!

title: Monsterella Fantasy Makeup
description: Step into the monstrous world of beauty with "Monsterella Fantasy Makeup". This spookily engaging game lets you work your makeover magic on three iconic cartoon characters. In Frankie's unit, electrify her look with eerie eyeshadows, neon lipstick, shockingly cool hairstyles, and otherworldly outfits. Next, embrace Clawdeen's earthy mystique with jewel-toned makeup and howl-inducing wardrobe choices. Finally, express Draculaura's vamp chic vibe with dramatic makeup and goth-glam ensembles.

title: Merge Blocks 2048
description: Swipe to slide numbered tiles on a 4x4 grid. Match two identical blocks to merge them into a bigger number. Start from 2 and work your way up to 2048 and beyond. The board fills up with every move so plan ahead. Chain multiple merges in a row to build combos and earn bonus coins. Spend coins in the shop on power-ups like Undo, Extra Life, Score Boost, Shuffle and Head Start. Beat your high score and try to reach the highest tile possible. Easy to learn, hard to master.

title: Sprunki Shooter 2025
description: Sprunki Shooter 2025 is a free to play online game that delivers exciting shooting action in a colorful and challenging world. Players must navigate through each level, clearing obstacles and defeating enemies to reach the exit. The goal is to complete all levels by unlocking the exit doors. To do this, players must shoot and collect all the scattered diamonds while avoiding or eliminating dangerous enemies along the way. Have fun!

title: Stickman Rescue Draw 2 Save
description: Your brain is the only shield for the stickman! Enjoy a super casual puzzler in the Stickman Rescue - Draw 2 Save. Use your finger to draw lines and save the stickman from danger! In each level, the stickman is in trouble, such as falling rocks, flying arrows, deep pits, etc. It’s up to you to draw a safe shield, a bridge, or a clever device to keep him safe and complete your rescue mission!

title: Bubble Shooter Witch Tower 2
description: Bubble Shooter: Witch Tower 2 brings back the magic in a fun, family-friendly way! Pop colorful bubbles, unlock cozy enchanted rooms, and help the Witch Tower shine again. Meet adorable familiars, enjoy charming details, and celebrate the magic of every season — even a touch of Halloween spookiness! Easy to play for all ages, with plenty of bubble-shooting fun to enjoy anytime.

title: Block Eating Simulator
description: The battle of the blocks begins in the block's arena with this great eating simulator game. Eat blocks around and grow your cube. Become the biggest block of the arena. Find various cube skins. Play single or 2 player! Cube players are all around the arena and they are eating blocks, cubes, and lower-scored players. Each block you eat will give you some points. Try to eat as many blocks as possible and try to eat low-scored players. Try to get to the top of the leaderboard.

title: Pop Fruit
description:
Pop Fruit is a bright and relaxing fruit-sorting puzzle game. Each bubble contains different fruits, and your goal is to pick the right fruits and place them into baskets. Match three identical fruits in a basket to clear them and keep the board moving.
Plan your moves carefully, because baskets have limited space.
Clear fruits, complete each level, and unlock more challenging stages with new fruit combinations.

title: Thrill Roller Coaster
description: Thrill Roller Coaster is a fun 3D roller coaster simulator game. Press and hold to accelerate forward, your speed and acceleration is fast enough for you to reach the other end of the track. Watch out for the brakes in the middle and drive the roller coaster at breakneck speeds now! Experience speed and passion!

title: Emoji Challenge
description: Emoji Challenge is an engaging skill game. Featuring levels constructed entirely with popular emojis. The game offers six distinct puzzle types: link puzzle, memory puzzle, word quiz, related puzzle, shadow puzzle, and crop puzzle. This game is perfect for players who enjoy brain teasers and want to test their problem-solving skills.

title: Cozy Kitchen Merge
description: This is an addictive cooking-themed merge game you won't be able to put down. Here, you'll become a kitchen master by merging identical ingredients and dishes to create new, more delicious cuisine. From simple vegetables to exotic feasts, continuously unlock tasty recipes from around the world. Fulfill customer orders to earn coins, and use them to upgrade and decorate your kitchen, transforming it from a humble diner into a dream culinary paradise.

title: Flag Puzzle Jam: Collect Flags
description: Immerse yourself in Flag Jam, a unique blend of puzzle-solving, flags collecting, and visual ASMR effects! Tap to match banner pieces, watch them glide smoothly into place, and clear the board as you complete each flag. With easy-to-learn mechanics and stunning visual effects, Flag Jam is the perfect game to help you unwind.

title: Animal Transform Race
description: Animal Transform Race is a fun game based on reaction where different types of animals compete. Each animal is fast in some areas and very slow in some tracks according to their abilities. Try to lead the race by making the right choices. The faster you make animal choices, the more advantages you gain. You can unlock new animals from the market section with the coins you earn from the races.

title: Hangman Saga
description: Challenge your vocabulary with Hangman Saga! With thousands of levels, each word includes a category hint to guide you—like "Profession" for "Doctor." Guess the letters wisely, but too many mistakes end the game! Need help? Use the hint button for a clue. Perfect for all ages, this fun and educational word puzzle will keep you entertained while sharpening your spelling skills. Can you solve them all?

title: Winter Mahjong
description: You can test your pattern detection skills in this relaxed mahjong & connect puzzle game with winter christmas theme. You can eliminate pair of same tiles. The line connecting the two clicked tiles can't have more than 2 corners. Some levels the tiles can auto slide( to left, to right, to up, to bottom). Can you clear the board before time runs out? Enjoying matching winter tiles with 32 levels in this game.

title: Ice Skating Ballerina
description: Dive into a winter wonderland and help Ellie and Ben prep for an exciting ice skating competition. Customize skates, curate dazzling outfits, and make a style statement on the ice. Browse through a vast collection of colorful ballerina and glam outfits, chic accessories, and shoes. Glide, twirl, and experience the fun-filled, fashion-centric icy adventure with this engaging dress-up game for girls.

title: Sweetsu Tile Puzzle
description: Sweet Tile Puzzle is a relaxing yet strategic game. Match 3 identical Japanese-themed tiles by drawing them into a limited stack. Clear the board by collecting all tiles while managing space wisely. With each level, challenges grow as the stack shrinks and more tiles appear. Can you master the art of tile matching?

title: Cannon Shooter
description: Cannon Shooter is an exciting arcade shooter where you can have endless shooting fun in fast-paced combat! You will control a cannonball firing hordes of heroic characters, facing many enemies. A quick click to launch more heroes and help you generate more heroes through the digital gate.

title: Ragdoll Mega Dunk
description:
Welcome to the Ragdoll Mega Dunk indoor extreme basketball club! The game is a cool Ragdoll style basketball simulator .
Every attempt to do a trick will be unique! Throw the ball into the basket and fly there yourself!

title: Huggy Wuggy Guess the right door
description: In Huggy Wuggy -Guess the right door you have to find your way through a maze like factory, choosing the right way. In each room there are 3 doors, but behind one of them you will find Huggy Wuggy. You have to go through 50 rooms if you want to find the exit. Try your best and leave this haunted place as fast as you can!

title: Tralala Connect
description:
Tralala Connect – the ultimate Italian Brainrot meme puzzle!
Find and connect matching tiles featuring your favorite absurd meme characters.
Sharpen your focus and logic through 15 increasingly chaotic levels.
Unlock all 45 stars if your brain can handle the rot.
Mamma mia, it's peak concentration with a spicy twist!

title: Find The Missing Part
description: With 100 levels of increasingly challenging puzzles, this game will put your observation skills to the test like never before. Your task is to carefully examine the image and identify the missing sections from a set of 15 options provided. With only seconds to spare, you must make swift and accurate selections to complete the puzzle.

title: Happy Farm: The Crop
description: Happy Farm: The Crop is a farm-themed mahjong game with a customizable tiles appearance. If you enjoy creative twists on classic Mahjong games, this one will keep you entertained.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Battle Arena Race to Win
description: Battle Arena Race to Win is a high-octane arena game where you join the Red or Blue team and engage in fierce car battles. Choose from a variety of cars, collect and upgrade them to dominate the arena. Balance speed, durability, and acceleration to outmaneuver opponents. Equip your car with strategic items, upgrade for success, and climb the leaderboard to lead your team to victory!

title: Mermaid Wedding World
description: Mermaid Wedding World is a creative dress-up and decorating game for girls. The princess of the ocean kingdom is getting married to a human and they are going to have a wedding now. You can help prepare the food, set the table, serve the people, and play music. You may help the bride, groom,and other guests to dress up and makeup. You may also decorate the room to your liking.

title: Labuba Merge
description: Labuba Merge is a fun and relaxing casual merge game where you combine adorable fluffy Labuba to unlock bigger, cuter, and funnier versions! Perfect for kids and adults, this addicting merge puzzle game will challenge your strategy and bring a smile to your face. Just drag, drop, and merge your Labubas to evolve them into new forms. How big can your Labuba grow?

title: Cute Relaxing Matching 3 Tiles
description:
Fun Farm Wonderland is a light but extremely fun game from our team

Fun Farm Wonderland is a puzzle game combined with a Farm theme, to create a feeling of lightness and relaxation for all players participating in them.

Have you ever played a match 3 tiles game with such cute design and interface? If not, don't skip our game, for the following reasons

title: Panda Lu Treehouse
description: Hey, animal lovers! Enter the enchanting world of Panda Lu's Tree House, a super fun casual simulator that will warm your heart. In this game, you play as the caretaker of the adorable panda Lu. Your adventure begins by building a magnificent tree house, a cozy and vibrant home for your furry friend.

title: Stickman Miners Wars
description: Lead your stickman king to victory in Stickman Miners Wars, where strategic decision-making is key. Command an army of miners and warriors to build your forces and triumph over opponents. Upgrade your units and yourself as you gain experience, and strategically attack enemy castles while defending your own. Will your strategy lead you to dominance? Play Stickman Miners Wars now!

title: Purrfect Bakery
description: Purrfect Bakery is a cozy and heartwarming game where a sweet cat runs a bakery for cute animal customers. Serve yummy treats, unlock new adorable visitors, and enjoy the simple joy of baking and friendship!

title: Catch The Pig
description: This is a casual elimination game. The main purpose of the game is to find three identical pigs, catch them, and collect all the pig collections!

title: Sort Balls - Cones
description: Immerse yourself in a calming logic puzzle where your goal is to sort colored balls into separate tubes. Plan each move carefully so that every tube contains balls of only one color. The straightforward mechanics gradually evolve into more challenging levels that test your focus and strategic thinking.

title: Supermarket Shopping For Kids
description: Have you ever dreamed of owning your own supermarket? In this casual supermarket simulator game, you can make your dream come true! In our Supermarket Shopping For Kids game, you can not only enjoy shopping but also play as a cashier and check out items! Apart from that, there are also many fun mini-games you can join in the supermarket.

title: Fish Out of Water!
description:
Dive into a thrilling adventure with Fish Out of Water, without ads or in-app purchases. A captivating game by Halfbrick Studios, the creators of Fruit Ninja and Jetpack Joyride. Launch a group of brave fish pals into the sky and over the ocean, helping them travel far and bounce as much as possible!

Experience remastered graphics and audio and enjoy a rebalanced crystal unlocking system for a more rewarding experience.

title: Dusty Cat
description: Help the little speck of dust to grow into a real cat! Eat other dust, avoid larger enemies and grow to see all the phases of your Dusty Cat! Collect points and compete with other players to get your scores on the leaderboard!

title: Kings and Queens Match
description: Welcome to Kings and Queens Match! Dive into a magical kingdom , matching jewels and crowns to progress through levels. Unleash Royal Bombs, hammers, and wands for extra fun. Stunning graphics and an enchanting soundtrack will transport you to a world of magic and wonder. So what are you waiting for? Join Princess Bella on her quest for treasure and adventure today!

title: Squid Game Memory Card Match
description:
Step into the thrilling world of Squid Game Memory Card Match! Test your memory and focus as you uncover pairs of iconic Squid Game symbols and characters. Can you keep your cool under pressure and match all the cards before time runs out?
Challenge yourself or compete with friends to see who can master the ultimate memory test. With Squid Game Memory Card Match, every flip brings you closer to victory or defeat – can you handle the pressure?

title: Sandbox - Destroy the Ragdoll
description:
Ready to destroy and earn? In this sandbox clicker, it's simple: choose your weapon, attack characters, and get paid for the damage you deal. The stronger your attacks, the bigger the reward!  

Use different tactics, unlock new gear, and upgrade your firepower. The further you go, the more powerful the weapons and the greater the possibilities. Ready to become the strongest fighter? Then tap, destroy, and earn!

title: Cat vs Granny. Cat Simulator
description: Immerse yourself in madness and fun as a mischievous cat who decided to turn grandma's cozy house into a field of chaos! ? Break pots, steal fish from the aquarium, throw things and scratch everything that comes under your paw. And all this is in the form of a first-person simulator with elements of humor and mayhem.

title: Autumn Glam Gala
description: Get ready to light up the season with Autumn Glam Gala, a beauty makeup game, the ultimate fashion and makeup experience! Transform three besties into autumn-style icons for the gala of the year.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Tanks. Race for survival
description: In this exciting tank game, you compete with other players to be the first to reach the finish line, destroying enemy towers along your way. Control powerful tanks, use tactical thinking and strategic maneuvers to overcome obstacles and defeat opponents. Carefully plan your route, avoiding enemy attacks and traps on the path to victory. The thrilling survival race begins here!

title: MycoThreeMemo
description: Welcome to the quiet hunt, mushroom picker! Embark on an exciting journey through a virtual forest where mushrooms change shape depending on their habitat and the time of the year! In this puzzle game, you have to be careful and have a good memory to find three mushrooms of the same species. Keep in mind that even mushrooms of the same species can look different! Don't forget that there may be a lot of mushrooms in the forest, but your time is always limited. Think fast, but accurately!

title: The Walking Deadblocks
description: A fast-paced, cooperative survival game where players battle relentless waves of zombies across dynamic day-night cycles. Survive as long as possible by managing resources, unlocking new maps, and utilizing unique character abilities. Nights bring increased danger with randomized enemy spawns, challenging players to strategize using generators and lights to stay alive.

title: Baby Penguin Fishing
description: Tiny Fishing is a fun and addictive 2D puzzle fishing simulation game that challenges your skills. Enjoy this charming game as you explore a fishing adventure. The game has two modes: Fishing and Trawling. In Fishing mode, you cast your line by clicking on each fish’s body and catch them quickly to advance to the next level. In Trawling mode, you release the net by clicking on the desired area and capture everything within it. You also have to complete the objective fast.

title: Stickman Warrior Way
description:
Epic battles, complex labyrinths with multiple paths and treacherous enemies await you in the game!

You will have to pass difficult tests in the fight against an ancient evil that wants to destroy all existing worlds.
 Only you can prevent the destruction of the universe and save other worlds from destruction.

18 challenging levels and mazes are waiting for you.
2 or more ways to pass the level
Save this world to give the rest of the universe a chance!

title: Color Sand Puzzle
description: Welcome to Color Sand Puzzle! Relax and unwind with Color Sand Puzzle, a refreshing take on the classic block puzzle game! Your mission is simple yet fun—fill the grid with matching colors of sand to clear and control the lines. As colorful sand blocks fall from the top, you’ll need to strategically arrange them to form complete horizontal rows. When the sand lines up from left to right, they disappear, and you earn points!

title: Snake.io
description: Snake.io is an online io game where you control a snake, striving to survive in a battlefield of other snakes. Consume colorful food to grow larger and defeat rivals to become a formidable forceOur Review“Snake.io is a frenzied battle of the snakes, full of fast-paced fights.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: RealDrive
description: RealDrive - Feel the real drive is a driving simulator game in which you can do drift racing, traffic racing, and some tuning. Play the most realistic car simulator 2021!
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Push Them!
description: Push Them! is a shooting game where your goal is to push the annoying red stickmen to fall into the water.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Mutant run
description: When you are running on a track full of various obstacles, you need to choose to go through the mutation gate to evolve your body, gain the talents of specific animals, and clear the obstacles in the road!

title: Free the Ball
description: Try out Free the Ball, a super fun puzzle game! Your job is to guide the ball to its goal by moving blocks around. And get this – there are a whopping three thousand levels to play, and they're all free! No need to buy anything.

title: Merge Brick Breaker
description: Welcome to Merge Brick Breaker, the ultimate fusion of ball merging and brick-breaking action! Get ready to embark on a thrilling adventure that challenges your strategic skills and reflexes.

title: Upside Down
description:
Upside Down is a puzzle platformer game in which you must control the character, gather all of the stars and keys, and complete all of the levels.

The levels are difficult and mental exercises. In order to finish the levels, you have to switch between two distinct worlds. The lovely graphics and calming soundtrack make the game enjoyable and lovely. Go through the portal, leap, run, get away, and enjoy yourself.

title: Magic Kingdom. Hex Match
description: Magic Kingdom: Hex Match is a game where you are the third son of a great king, sent to a distant land to prove your worth. Collect six vital resources—food, water, stone, wood, workers, and metal—to construct new buildings. Unlock all structures and create a stunning, magical kingdom!

title: Geometry Subzero
description: Welcome to Ice Age in Geometry Subzero! The new interface of this game has captured any player's heart. Instead of a basic interface, you can experience the cold air when it's snowy in this game. The main character is a little monster who is frozen. The monster moves forward on a road with many spikes. Move, jump, and slide to overcome these dangers! In this game, the diversity of characters is one attractive feature. You can move a turtle, penguin, seal, etc to overcome challenges in this game.

title: Baby Piano Children Song
description:
Do you like playing musical instruments? If you love music, we have just the game for you. This educational game offers 5 musical instruments to choose from. They are piano, xylophone, flute, drums, and guitar. You can select the instrument you are interested in playing. Apart from
offering a wide range of instruments, this game lets you choose your favorite music.

title: Wall Hop
description: Every wall has a purpose. Every move is a lesson. Learn the mechanics, feel the flow, and gradually unlock the mental agility needed to navigate increasingly complex challenges.

title: Spooky Chains
description: Spooky Chains is a fun Halloween puzzle game. Tap a tile and drag through matching nearby items to make a chain of 3 or more. The items vanish, and the tiles turn golden. Your goal is to turn all tiles golden. Sometimes a Flying Witch glides across the board. Tap her while she flies to watch a reward ad. After the ad, she blasts some tiles into golden. You can also watch a reward ad to remove the timer and play without time pressure.

title: Poopy Escape The Prison
description: Help Poopy, a mischievous (and slightly stinky) inmate, break out of a maximum-security prison! Navigate through hazardous cells, evade ruthless guards, solve puzzles, and uncover hidden paths to escape. But beware—one wrong move, and Poopy lands in solitary confinement!

title: Ice Cream Roller!
description:
Run to get your ice cream ball as big as possible and fill it with fruits so it would be much more tasty for the kid at the end!

Avoid getting hit by obstacles if you don't want to lose ice cream!

title: Marble Puzzle Quest
description: Marble Puzzle Quest is a fun and addictive casual puzzle game where your task is to sort colorful marbles into the correct slots. With each new level, the challenge grows — chains become longer and more colorful, while the space for moves gets tighter. Use logic, plan ahead, and clear the board! Watch out: the marbles fill four slots at the top, and only three of the same color will disappear. Place them incorrectly, and you lose the round.

title: Safari Story Mahjong
description: Set off on a bright Safari Story Mahjong adventure filled with animals, plants, fruits, and sunny nature tiles! Match free pairs, clear relaxing Mahjong boards, and journey through a colorful saga map packed with cheerful safari moments. Complete levels before time runs out, unlock Gift Box milestones every 8 levels, and collect helpful boosters like Hint, Shuffle, Undo, Torch, and Freeze. A light, rewarding puzzle escape for players who love casual Mahjong fun.

title: My Cat Restaurant
description: Welcome to My Cat Restaurant, a casual kids cooking simulator game that you can play for free. Act as a chef and restaurant manager. Take orders, cook food, serve customers, and collect money. Plan your moves and workload in advance, and figure out an efficient routine.

title: Stickman The Flash
description: Stickman The Flash is a fighting RPG arcade game with 2D stickman warriors. In the Survival Mode, you need to survive as long as you can by dodging red areas and killing incoming enemies. You can collect different weapons when you kill the corresponding enemies. When you earn enough gems, you can unlock and equip them in the Equipment Store, and they will increase your full abilities. Keep calm and slaughter them all!

title: Rope King
description: The Rope King is a fun and casual competitive game. In the game, players will control the characters to perform various strange rope skipping challenges. The game is simple and easy to use, the theme is humorous and funny, the game style is exquisite and creative, and it is matched with various funny actions and cool and dynamic sound effects. You will definitely love it.

title: Bull Runner
description: Take control of a powerful bull as it charges forward at full speed! Smash through obstacles, knock over stickmen, and leave destruction in your wake. How far can you go before something stops you? Test your reflexes and unleash the unstoppable force of the raging bull!

title: Infinite Craft
description: This is a crafting game in which you start with four elements - Fire, Earth, Water, and Wind. Combine elements to create new elements. Find bizarre and fun combos. Enjoy an open and stress-free exploration experience.

title: The Counterfeit Bank
description:
The Counterfeit Bank: Fake Money Tycoon Simulator
Think Plague Inc, but with counterfeit cash! Your goal: dominate the economy one fake note at a time.
Taxes are soaring, inflation’s out of control, and recession looms—perfect chaos for your evil plan. Print counterfeit money, outsmart enforcers, and flood the market with fake cash to disrupt the system.
Can you survive the chaos and take over the economy before time runs out? Mwahahaha!

title: Word Mine
description: Word Mine takes you on a thrilling journey where letters are your treasure! Dive into a world of scrambled chaos and uncover hidden words buried in the grid. With every move, you’ll strike gold, revealing secrets that push you closer to victory. Sharpen your mind, follow the clues, and let the adventure unfold—one word at a time!

title: Checkers Deluxe Edition
description:
It's a clash on the battlefield! Draw up your plan and defeat your opponents with finesse!

It is also known as the draughts game, and it is an interesting test of strategy. Compete with an opponent and dominate their pieces as best you can.

What happens when you manage to move a piece to the other end? Come play now and let's find out!

title: Slithoria
description:
Slithoria is a fast-paced arcade game where you compete to become the biggest snake in the arena. Collect glowing orbs, grow larger, outsmart your rivals, and survive as long as possible.

Defeat other snakes by cutting them off, collect the orbs they leave behind, and grow even faster. Unlock 40 unique skins by completing challenges and customize your snake.

With smooth controls and colorful visuals, every match is a new challenge.

Enter the arena and become the biggest snake in Slithoria!

title: Epic Hero Quest Idle RPG
description:
Conquer enemies, level up heroes, unlock skills in Epic Hero Quest: Idle RPG!

- Battle Through Hordes of Enemies
- Earn Gold and Level Up
- Unlock and Upgrade Skills

Are you ready to embark on the ultimate adventure? 
Join the quest  and become the legendary hero you were destined to be in Epic Hero Quest: Idle RPG!

title: Ropeway Master
description:
Ropeway Master is a new challenging puzzle game. You should utilize the rope to free everyone,control the rope, overcome the obstacles, and complete the demanding and unique puzzle game. The
game is not difficult! Drag the rope to make a safe path, control the rope, and rescue everyone.Don't forget to avoid the obstacles along the way. If you play Rope Puzzle, make sure you do nothing. You will play for hours and linger.

title: 100 Hidden Capybaras
description: Are you ready for a hidden object game that's as cute as it is challenging? Jump into "100 Hidden Capybaras" – the ultimate hidden object adventure where your mission is to find and collect 100 adorable capybaras, each hiding in beautifully designed scenes! Explore stunning environments filled with lush forests, charming villages, secret dungeons, and unknown planets. Discover all hiding spots for our fluffy friends as you put your observation skills to the test.

title: Merge Muscle
description: Create the most powerful gym, connect athletes!  A large gym is at your disposal. Your task is to get new athletes, combine similar ones to get more powerful athletes. The most powerful athletes can be taken to a boxing competition. You need to click as often and quickly as possible to defeat your opponent in a difficult battle.

title: Word Guess Game
description: Are you good at guessing a word from provided letters in random order? Here is a word-guessing puzzle game with arcade play rules. There are four different modes with more letters from four to seven. More difficult modes have more time for you to use. Keep calm and make a new reword!

title: Hexa puzzle
description:
Stretch your mind and train your brain with this addictive block puzzle game. Can you solve all of the hundreds of free puzzles?

Put your mind and brain to work to solve the puzzle game by placing the unique hexagon pieces neatly into the puzzle grid. Merge each hexo shaped piece into the grid one by one. Similar to Tetris, they all need to fit together to complete the puzzle. You may need more time to match all the blocks into the super perfect spot - but that's fine, there are no time limit!

title: Two Carts - Downhill
description: Two Carts - Downhill is a fast-paced arcade game where you control two carts simultaneously, each on its own obstacle-filled road. Use the left and right arrow keys to steer each cart independently, collecting components to score points. Pick up power-ups like Ice to slow down the game or Shield to protect against obstacles. As you progress, the game speeds up, challenging your reflexes and multitasking skills. How long can you keep both carts on track?

title: Jeli2D
description: A game in the genre of 2048. Skillfully use the game physics to your advantage. The goal of the game is to connect the jell to the maximum size and not to lose. There is a boosters in the game, which will make it fun and easier to pass the game.

title: Spinning Uia Uia Cat Bricker
description: Spinning Uia Uia Cat Bricker is a fun and addictive brick-breaking game where a lively cat motivates you with cheerful meows. Your goal is to clear all the bricks without dropping the ball. As you break more bricks, the cat gets even more excited, dancing and playing around. With colorful graphics and dynamic gameplay, this game offers a delightful experience for players of all ages. Stay sharp and keep up!

title: Sniper vs Sniper
description: Sniper vs. Sniper is a game where players compete in sniper shooting skills. Each player takes on the role of a sniper, participating in intense battles with an opponent. Exciting long-distance sniper duels where key skills include accuracy, strategy, and quick reaction.

title: Wordling: Daily Word Challenge
description: Wordling is a fun, free daily word puzzle game where you guess the hidden word in 6 tries using color-coded clues. Perfect for adults and seniors who love brain games, spelling challenges, and relaxing, ad-free gameplay. Explore all game modes!

title: Hero Tower War
description:
Many monsters and enemies in the tower. You need to defeat them, get treasures and save hostages.

You can play everywhere ,every time. It is a boring killer game.

title: Doge Bubble
description: Doge Bubble is a classic bubble shooter game with multiple challenging levels. Doge Bubbles features the classic bubble shooter gameplay with 3 powerups: The rocket that clears the chosen path, the bomb that clears up to 8 bubbles at a time and the multi color bubble. The goal in each level is to "free" all the doge bubbles.

title: Backgammon Duel
description:
One of the oldest, most played and loved games, the classic backgammon game. 

Also known as Tavli (Greece), Tawla (Egypt), and Takteh (Iranian), but whatever you call it you can download it now and challenge yourself.

title: Puzzle Blocks: Fill It Completely
description:
Discover the world of exciting puzzles!

In this game, you have to collect shapes by filling them with blocks of different sizes and configurations. Each task is a unique logical task that requires attention, patience and a strategic approach.
Various difficulty levels - from easy for beginners to difficult for real masters.
Original shapes and blocks - each level is unique.

title: Marble Sort
description: Marble Sort is a fun and satisfying puzzle game where colorful marbles travel along a conveyor belt waiting to be sorted. Fill matching trays, complete sets of three identical marbles, and clear every level. Plan your moves carefully, manage the flow, and enjoy smooth animations, relaxing gameplay, and rewarding sorting challenges. Easy to learn, hard to master!

title: Math Box Balance
description: Math Box Balance is a puzzle game with numbers. Early levels have 2 boxes, and as you progress you can reach up to 8 boxes. Each box contains 4 number blocks, and the sum of these numbers is shown inside the box. Your goal is to make the sum of all boxes equal. You can swap number blocks between boxes to achieve the equal sum. It is an endless game where the difficulty increases over time, your score goes up, and the fun grows with it.

title: Cool Girl Aesthetics
description: In Cool Girl Aesthetics, join Mia as she creates her ultimate trendy look! Start by customizing her Stanley cup with fun colors, prints, and accessories. Then, style her headphones, giving them a unique vibe. Next, design her manicure with cool colors, rings, and temporary tattoos for a stylish edge. Complete the look with makeup options like face stickers, colorful braces, and more. Dive into this fun, creative dress-up, and makeover game for endless aesthetic options.

title: Panda Mahjong Classic
description: The panda has a challenge for you. You will face five tests on your way to the top. Attempt to finish all stages and earn the honor of being a Mahjong master.

title: Heist Defender
description: "Heist Defender" immerses players in the heart-pounding world of high-stakes bank robberies, where they take on the role of an elite security expert tasked with preventing a daring heist. As the mastermind behind the bank's defense systems, players must employ strategic thinking, quick reflexes, and cutting-edge technology to thwart the cunning thieves and protect the bank's vault from being plundered.

title: Mini Scrapbook Paper
description: Mini Scrapbook Paper is a super cute art game made for girls. Do you have a journal? Have you ever designed your journal with your own style? In this game, you can design a journal freely. With colorful pages, fancy stickers and other cute accessories we prepared for you, you can use your imagination as much as you like. Have a good time!

title: Block Puzzle Travel
description:
The goal of the game is to destroy as many blocks as possible. By doing so, you will earn points for completing the game perfectly.
By solving puzzles, you train your attention, thought processes and brain.
In this game you have to achieve the maximum result, and pass all levels.

title: Sort And Style: Back To School
description: Step into the world of Sort And Style: Back To School, a fun mix of sorting and dress-up games for girls! Organize messy desks, lockers, wardrobes, and even bento boxes across 9 exciting levels. Then, challenge your creativity in the final dress-up unit where you style your school look with trendy uniforms, shoes, hairstyles, and accessories. Perfect for fans of organizing games, makeover fun, and school fashion challenges!

title: Unlock the Bolts
description: Unlock the Bolts is a challenging puzzle game where you carefully remove screws to solve mechanical puzzles. Each level tests your logic and precision as you figure out the correct order to unlock the bolts. In special levels, the stakes are even higher—you must free trapped animals by unlocking the right bolts! With satisfying mechanics and engaging challenges, this game will keep you thinking and entertained. Can you master every puzzle and rescue the animals in need?

title: Find Sort Match
description: Find Sort Match is a fun and creative puzzle that combines sort and match elements. Let you experience the joy of DIY! In the game, sort and match items of various shapes, colors, and types. And complete each level of the challenge.

title: Merge Squares
description: "Merge Squares" is an exciting puzzle game, where your task is to connect squares with same numbers. Using logic and strategic mind, you have to decide how to arrange the squares to combine them into one. Each level gets harder, how far can you go?

title: Zumble Story
description: Explore every corner of the jungle, create combinations and shoot colorful marbles. With each level, face unique challenges and utilize powerful boosters to enhance your skills. Unlock exciting chapters, conquer obstacles, and experience a vibrant journey full of surprises!

title: Office Brawl - Room Smash
description:
Become the hero of an office rebellion and destroy everything in your path! The player will have to transform into a disgruntled employee who challenges the system, destroys obstacles and fights the boss.

Use brute force and ingenuity to get through difficult tests, participate in intense battles and explosive actions.
Become an antihero and sow chaos from start to finish!

title: Bus Driver Simulator 3D
description:
Bus Driver Simulator 3D is a bus simulator in which you will be able to drive different types of buses traveling around different parts of the world including Los Angeles, Berlin, Rome, Alaska and so on.

Each scenario in Bus Driver Simulator 3D has special characteristics. So, for example, in Alaska you will be driving on snowy tundra, and other cars will not be very much, but on the city highway in Los Angeles the traffic will be more intense.

title: Bridge Wars
description: Gear up for Bridge Wars, a mobile gaming epic blending creativity and strategy. Immerse in a world where tactical mastery meets artistic flair. Draw patterns, summon stickman defenders in 3 seconds, facing relentless enemy vehicles. Upgrade characters, navigate intense environments, and stop foes from breaching. Embark on a thrilling adventure, showcasing tactical mastery against relentless waves!

title: Word Rush
description: Word Rush combines solitaire mechanics with word puzzles for a unique and addictive experience! Clear lettered cards by forming words, drawing new cards from the deck to create high-scoring combinations. Each move opens up fresh opportunities, keeping the game exciting and dynamic. With endless word possibilities, Word Rush offers fun for everyone, from casual players to word puzzle enthusiasts. Challenge your vocabulary and strategy skills in this thrilling game!

title: Hit Knock Down
description: Hit & Knock Down is a fun casual game where you aim to throw baseballs. Shoot as many targets as possible. Test your precision, reaction speed, and throwing skills. You aim to hit the right targets in each level. The goals at the level are very varied, such as wood, stone, etc. Each level presents different targets. You should hit with a baseball.

title: Pool Bubbles
description: Pool Bubbles is a bubble shooter game with a pool theme. Eliminate pool balls by shooting balls of the same color to a minimum of 3.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Granny GTA Vegas
description: Granny GTA Vegas drops the infamous horror legend into the heart of sin city! Armed and unhinged, Granny escapes her haunted house and brings chaos to the neon streets of Las Vegas. With red-hooded masked enemies hot on her trail, she must shoot her way through crime-ridden alleys, casino districts, and the Vegas Strip.

title: LinkLink
description:
Round and cute animal blocks are piled up.
If you connect the same types together, you can get points by disappearing!
Let's compete to see who gets the highest score in a minute

title: Travel Mahjong Deluxe
description: Travel Mahjong Deluxe is a relaxing tile-matching puzzle where you match identical tiles and strategically clear the board. Find pairs of beautiful travel-themed tiles that are free on at least one side and remove them to complete each level. As you progress, new layouts and challenges will keep the game fresh and engaging. Use the Hint feature whenever you get stuck, or watch a reward video to gain unlimited time and continue your puzzle-solving adventure.

title: Weaponsmith Evolution - Weapon Merge
description:
- Start with basic weapons and drag identical ones to merge them into more powerful versions.
- Each new weapon brings more gold.
- Spend gold on upgrades: unlock new types of weapons or speed up the merging process.
- Fight monsters and progress through levels.
- From time to time, you’ll encounter powerful bosses. Defeat them to prove your mastery!

title: Hole Digger
description: Grab your shovel and start your journey deep into the earth. Mine valuable resources, upgrade your tools, level up your skills, and unlock new opportunities for even faster digging. The deeper you dig, the richer the treasures. Can you reach the very bottom?

title: Gravity Matcher
description: In Gravity Matcher, you’ll launch circles of various sizes and types into a dynamic gravity field. Your goal? Match identical circles by carefully aiming and timing your throws. But beware – gravity is unpredictable, and the slightest miscalculation can send your circles spiraling out of control!

title: Miner Cat 4
description: Miner Cat 4 is a side-view Minecraft-inspired game with a Scratch cat character!   Welcome to Miner Cat 4.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Oreplication
description: Sandbox strategy tycoon where you design factories for infinite wealth. Start with basic droppers & conveyors, upgrade to advanced machines. Deep progression, mystery boxes, endless optimization—build, outsmart, ascend in the ultimate factory challenge!

title: Magic Flow
description: Magci Flow are puzzle series solved by transferring liquids. Players must strategically use container capacities to sort liquids in the fewest moves. Tasks include merging same-colored liquids or precise sequencing, rigorously testing judgment skills.

title: Family Simulator Beach Games
description: Get ready to enjoy exciting winter holidays with your virtual family in this fun filled family vacation simulator. Travel with mom, dad, and family members to beautiful vacation destinations and experience memorable picnic adventures. Complete thrilling activities, explore amazing locations, and enjoy realistic family life in this vacation simulator game.

title: Bus Escape: Clear Jam
description:
Dismantle the bus and send the passengers home in this colorful parking puzzle that delivers both fun and a brain workout. Combining simple gameplay with increasing difficulty, the game is perfect for fans of strategic puzzles and driving simulators.
Get ready for the challenge: sort the cars, find the right solutions, and free up parking spaces. Each car and bus has a limited number of seats, so plan your moves carefully to untangle the chaotic traffic jam.

title: Horror Escape Granny Room
description:
In case you are ready for a creepy adventure full of horror and exploration, then choose Horror Escape: Granny Room without hesitation! In our game, you are going to go on a dangerous journey.
Collect clues and keys while trying to escape the clutches of horrible granny. Your path is full of dangers. You must dodge the monsters lurking in the dark corners.  To unlock these areas, you must collect keys and reveal secrets. What awaits you? Only time will tell.

title: FNF Unblocked​ Italian Brainrot
description: Face a funny musical battle. FNF Unblocked - Italian Brainrot brings the classic FNF gameplay into the chaotic world of Italian brainrot. Hit the right arrow keys on beat to win rap battles. Face bizarre and iconic opponents like Sponge, Mustard, Sprunki, and other meme legends. Each level has a different style of music, even a little horror, so you can't help but sway to it! In addition, you can experience another gameplay.

title: Apple Worm
description: Play Apple Worm now. This is a classic puzzle game with simple operation. Brain-burning levels make you love it! Control a cute little worm whose goal is to eat the apple and upgrade. Upgrading allows you to unlock more cute skins. You can also earn rewards by completing challenges. Unlock Auto ATK, Summoning, etc. Enter the snakey mode. Control your worm and eat the apples. Go through the obstacles and enter the portal without any problems!

title: Tiny Cars
description: Tiny Cars is a colorful arcade traffic management game where players must avoid collisions. With a top-down view and engaging gameplay, this game features 50 base stages set in various locations like crossroads, squares, and highways. After completing the initial 50 levels, players will encounter the same environments with increased difficulty, offering a challenging and addictive experience for traffic control enthusiasts. Enjoy managing the traffic and becoming a master of Tiny Cars, the ultimate arcade traffic management game!

title: The Prism City Detectives
description: Embark on a vibrant adventure with "The Prism City Detectives" and join Luna, Ruby, Skye, Willow, Daisy, Violet, and Lumi in restoring color to their monochrome city! Explore dazzling dress-up levels and unravel hidden objects mysteries to find the missing Rainbow Gem and bring back the hues of unity.

title: Bullet Heroes
description:
Join the ultimate team-based shooting game! Team up with players worldwide to strategize, outsmart, and dominate your enemies. Experience intense firefights on stunning high-definition 3D maps, with multiple game modes and a vast arsenal of weapons. Become an elite agent, master your skills, and lead your team to victory.
Dive into the action and enjoy the thrill of cooperative gameplay. 
Are you ready to become a hero?

title: Wild West Match 3
description: Saddle up for a Wild West adventure in Bubble Shooter Wild West! Join Sheriff Bonnie as you pop colorful bubbles to defend your frontier town. Travel through dusty deserts, lively saloons, and scenic canyons while enjoying toe-tapping country tunes. Track your progress with detailed stats showing your best, current, and previous scores across Novice, Expert, and Master modes. With its vibrant Western visuals and exciting challenges, this bubble shooter brings cowboy spirit to every pop!

title: Human Leap Evolution
description: Want a wild evolution adventure from caveman to futuristic super warrior? Human Leap: Evolution is a high-energy action evolution puzzle game where every jump you make shapes your destiny. Choose wisely, evolve rapidly, and battle your enemies with unstoppable power!

title: Revoxel 3D - Voxel RPG Shooter
description: Immerse yourself in a dynamic voxel-style RPG shooter with a cyberpunk atmosphere. A dark futuristic city overrun by a tech corporation awaits you, along with endless battles with robots and monsters, character development, and constant action in the spirit of a shooter RPG.

title: Super Brain
description: In the game, you'll control a character sprinting down a track, but your path is blocked by a series of "Gates of Knowledge." Each gate presents an interesting question, and you must choose the lane corresponding to the correct answer in a short amount of time to pass through. A wrong choice ends the run! As you get faster, the questions become trickier. This game tests not only your knowledge but also your on-the-spot reaction skills. Come join this dual challenge of brain and speed!

title: Sorting Xmas Balls
description:
Sorting Xmas Balls is a cozy winter puzzle game where you sort colorful Christmas ornaments into their correct tubes. Move the balls, group matching colors together, and enjoy calm, festive gameplay.

As you progress, the puzzles become more challenging with more tubes and more colors to organize. Bright graphics and a cheerful holiday theme make every level relaxing and satisfying to complete.

title: Nose Hospital
